contracts: Only C31/C47 registration, fixed-only routing and post-run acceptance are added to the existing verifier.
Baseline preparation and paired direct evidence paths reject these cases.
Manifest matches exact main-based production revisions, reviewed generator hashes, generated source hashes/sizes and closed numeric case counts.
Generator evaluation uses the exact bytes checked against the reviewed manifest, avoiding stale import-cache rendering.
Generated source, object and executable remain anonymous memfds; added code does not persist source/IR/result payloads.
Existing receipt verification runs before and after actual execution; receipt bytes and generator bytes are checked again before success.
Fixed acceptance requires successful build provenance, actual compile/link/native records, nonempty object/executable hashes, complete cleanup and no watchdog/output overflow.
Every expected case is present exactly once; duplicate JSON keys, bool-as-int indices/counts/exit codes and unexpected fields reject.
Evidence explicitly keeps query_semantics_verified and quality_improvement_verified false, and no original case status is automatically promoted.
Existing serial-slot work-state/source-freeze admission and resource bounds remain unchanged.
limitations: The first real RBO closure build and link extraction can still expose unavailable archive members, platform flags or constructor/API issues; mocks do not demonstrate compile feasibility.
C31 direct contracts cover the current24 identity/admission cases, not new aggregate-copy stability or broader floating/composite/volatile identity scope.
C47 direct contracts use the amended ReadSettings API and therefore provide fixed-only local evidence, never pinned-main query equivalence.
Domain reconstruction sharing origin still requires actual physical graph inspection in the separate SQL/native acceptance.
